notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Fish Idle players![/b]

We're thrilled to bring you an exciting new update filled with fresh features, visual enhancements, and fixes to make your underwater adventures even better. Here’s what’s new:

[b]Update Highlights:

Steam Deck Support:[/b]
We’ve enabled full support for the Steam Deck, ensuring a seamless and optimized experience on this portable device.

[b]Vsync Added:[/b]
Vsync is now available in the game settings, allowing you to synchronize the frame rate with your monitor's refresh rate for smoother visuals and reduced screen tearing.

[b]Visual Fixes:[/b]
We’ve implemented several visual improvements, including refined textures, lighting adjustments, and animation fixes. Fish and boats are now correctly positioned, enhancing the overall visual quality.

[b]Adapted Interface Scale:[/b]
The user interface has been scaled and adapted for improved readability and accessibility across various screen sizes and resolutions.

[b]Touchpad Joystick Removed:[/b]
In response to community feedback, we’ve removed the touchpad joystick from the screen to streamline controls.

[b]Camera Adjustments:[/b]
The main camera now features a more appropriate height and smoother transitions, providing a more comfortable and visually appealing gameplay experience.

[b]Right Stick Gamepad Sensitivity:[/b]
We’ve adjusted the sensitivity of the right stick to make it more comfortable to use. You can also make additional adjustments in the gamepad settings via the Steam menu, which is particularly useful for non-standard gamepads.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy these updates and enhancements. Happy fishing!

[b]Multicast Games[/b]

[i]Keep swimming, keep winning![/i]

notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
[b]We’re excited to share our latest update based on your feedback. Here’s what’s new in this patch:[/b]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the progress blocker from the game.
[*] Based on your feedback, we have expanded the prologue so you can continue playing without interruption.[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed several issues highlighted in your reviews and discussions, such as:
[list]
[*] Keyboard control issues
[*] FPS lock problems
[*] Fish that couldn't be caught
[*] And many other small bugs[/list]

[h3]Thank You:[/h3]
We’re thrilled by the huge response to our project and delighted that you enjoyed playing the prologue. We appreciate your patience as we worked through some technical issues at launch.

[h3]Feedback:[/h3]
If you encounter any more issues or have further feedback, feel free to reach out in the discussions, and we’ll respond as quickly as possible.
